Calculate Focal (Moving Window) PTRM

Source: R/focal_ptrm.R
geomorphon_ptrm_focal.Rd

Calculates Perceived Terrain Realism Metric (PTRM) for each pixel using a circular moving window. Produces a spatially-varying measure of local terrain complexity and realism.

Usage

geomorphon_ptrm_focal(
  x,
  radius = 3,
  mode = c("dem", "class"),
  coefficients = NULL,
  forms = "forms10",
  intercept = -38.02,
  normalizer = 69.96,
  search = 3,
  skip = 0,
  flat_angle_deg = 1,
  dist = 0,
  filename = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

SpatRaster. Digital Elevation Model (when mode = "dem") or pre-computed geomorphon classification (when mode = "class").

radius

Numeric. Integer window radius in cells (not map units). Default: 3. Larger values compute PTRM from larger neighborhoods.

mode

Character. Input type: "dem" to calculate geomorphons internally, or "class" if input is pre-computed geomorphon classification. Default: "dem".

coefficients

Named numeric vector. Custom PTRM coefficients, either named for the requested form system (length k) or a named ten-form vector, which is reduced to the requested system. If NULL, uses the paper weights from Rajasekaran et al. (2022), derived for reduced form systems. Default: NULL.

forms

Character. Form system to use: "forms10", "forms6", "forms5", or "forms4". Default: "forms10".

intercept

Numeric. PTRM intercept. Default: -38.02.

normalizer

Numeric. PTRM normalizer; must be finite and non-zero. Default: 69.96.

search

Numeric. Search radius for geomorphon calculation (only used when mode = "dem"). Default: 3.

skip

Numeric. Skip radius for geomorphon calculation (only used when mode = "dem"). Default: 0.

flat_angle_deg

Numeric. Flatness angle threshold in degrees (only used when mode = "dem"). Default: 1.0.

dist

Numeric. Flatness distance parameter (only used when mode = "dem"). Default: 0.

filename

Character. Output filename. If provided, the result is written to disk instead of returned in memory. Default: NULL.

overwrite

Logical. Overwrite existing file? Default: FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to geomorphons() when mode = "dem".

Value

A SpatRaster with raw focal PTRM scores. Values are not normalized to [0, 1] and may fall outside that range. Border cells are NA.

Details

The PTRM score measures local terrain realism on a continuous scale. Higher values indicate more realistic terrain patterns according to the perception model of Rajasekaran et al. (2022). The focal version applies this metric locally to map spatial variation in terrain complexity.

Computational Complexity:

  • Geomorphons: O(N × 8R) where R = search radius

  • Focal PTRM: O(N × W) where W ≈ π × radius²

  • Total: O(N × (8R + W))

For a 1000×1000 DEM with radius=5, search=7:

  • Expected runtime: 3-6 seconds on modern multi-core system

  • Memory: ~20 MB

Algorithm

Uses a two-pass approach for efficiency:

  1. Calculate geomorphons globally (if mode = "dem")

    • Applies the full geomorphon classification algorithm once

    • Produces classification raster with classes 1-10

  2. Apply focal PTRM calculation to each pixel's neighborhood

    • For each interior pixel, extracts geomorphon classes within circular window

    • Calculates proportions of each geomorphon form

    • Applies PTRM formula using empirical coefficients

    • Returns spatially-varying PTRM scores

This two-pass approach is much more efficient than recalculating geomorphons for each window (~38x speedup for typical parameters).

Window Type

Uses a circular window based on Euclidean distance. For an integer radius = r, includes all cells where sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) <= r.

Border Handling

Cells within radius distance of raster edges are set to NA, as their neighborhoods are incomplete. This prevents edge artifacts in the output.

Memory Requirements

For small/medium rasters, uses the fast C++ implementation requiring approximately 4 bytes per input cell plus 8 bytes per output cell (about 12 bytes per cell) in RAM. For large rasters that exceed half of the available memory, automatically falls back to block-processed terra::focal(), which is slower but avoids full-raster R matrices. Without filename, terra-backed temporary storage is used for intermediate results.

References

Rajasekaran, S.D., Kang, H., Čadík, M., Galin, E., Guérin, E., Peytavie, A., Slavík, P., & Mech, R. (2022). PTRM: Perceived Terrain Realism Metric. ACM Transactions on Applied Perception, 19(2), Article 5. doi:10.1145/3514244

Jasiewicz, J., Stepinski, T. (2013). Geomorphons - a pattern recognition approach to classification and mapping of landforms. Geomorphology, 182, 147-156. doi:10.1016/j.geomorph.2012.11.005

See also

geomorphon_ptrm(), geomorphons(), terra::focal()

Examples

library(terra)
library(rgeomorphon)

# Load example DEM
data("volcano", package = "datasets")
dem <- rast(volcano)
crs(dem) <- crs("EPSG:2193")
ext(dem) <- c(1756968, 1757578, 5917000, 5917870)

# Calculate focal PTRM with 5-cell radius
ptrm_focal <- geomorphon_ptrm_focal(dem, radius = 5, mode = "dem")
#> Warning: [subst] all 'from' values are missing, returning a copy of 'x'

# Compare different window sizes
ptrm_r3 <- geomorphon_ptrm_focal(dem, radius = 3)
#> Warning: [subst] all 'from' values are missing, returning a copy of 'x'
ptrm_r7 <- geomorphon_ptrm_focal(dem, radius = 7)
#> Warning: [subst] all 'from' values are missing, returning a copy of 'x'
